_note: Every value is extracted from a claim quote by compute.py, or computed here from values that were.

issued.basis: loads the RFI was issued to

submitted_pct.basis: percent of issued loads that submitted, as ERCOT states it

gw_requested.basis: approximate GW of requested interconnection capacity the submissions cover

cap_pct.basis: approximate percent of requested capacity the submissions cover

not_submitted.basis: issued minus submitted, asserted equal to the Medium Load responses not submitted

large_all.basis: Large Loads, all of which responded

large_mw.basis: the Large Load threshold in MW

medium_issued.basis: loads issued the RFI that are not Large Loads

medium_submitted.basis: submitted loads that are not Large Loads

large_pct.basis: approximate percent of requested capacity in Large Loads

gw_projects.basis: Large Load projects requesting more than 1 GW

gw_projects_pct.basis: percent of capacity those projects represent

west_ll.basis: West load zone Large Loads in the reviewed dataset

west_ml.basis: West load zone Medium Loads in the reviewed dataset

west_gw.basis: West load zone peak requested capacity, GW

west_loads.basis: West load zone loads, Large plus Medium

north_ll.basis: North load zone Large Loads in the reviewed dataset

north_ml.basis: North load zone Medium Loads in the reviewed dataset

north_gw.basis: North load zone peak requested capacity, GW

north_loads.basis: North load zone loads, Large plus Medium

south_ll.basis: South load zone Large Loads in the reviewed dataset

south_ml.basis: South load zone Medium Loads in the reviewed dataset

south_gw.basis: South load zone peak requested capacity, GW

south_loads.basis: South load zone loads, Large plus Medium

houston_ll.basis: Houston load zone Large Loads in the reviewed dataset

houston_ml.basis: Houston load zone Medium Loads in the reviewed dataset

houston_gw.basis: Houston load zone peak requested capacity, GW

houston_loads.basis: Houston load zone loads, Large plus Medium

zones_gw_sum.basis: sum of the four zones' GW, a drawing check, never printed as a statewide total

zones_loads_sum.basis: sum of the four zones' loads, a drawing check

reviewed.basis: loads in the reviewed dataset behind the zone page

na_large.basis: approximate N/A rate among Large Loads, percent

na_medium.basis: approximate N/A rate among Medium Loads, percent

na_later_pct.basis: how much more often 2028 and later projects answered N/A, percent

dev_reviewed.basis: developers whose verification responses were reviewed

second_round_pct.basis: percent of developers expected to get a second round RFI

days_to_report.basis: days from the November 5th meeting to the December 10th report

days_report_to_meeting.basis: days from the December 10th report to the December 17th open meeting

days_deadline_to_meeting.basis: days from the October 12th deadline to the November 5th meeting

bar_m.basis: thickness of one copper lamination, metres, a drawing scale for one GW

sep_m.basis: separator between laminations, metres, a drawing scale

pack_w_total.basis: face width of the gw_requested pack, metres, drawn and never printed

pack_w_west.basis: face width of the West pack, metres, drawn and never printed

pack_w_north.basis: face width of the North pack, metres, drawn and never printed

pack_w_south.basis: face width of the South pack, metres, drawn and never printed

pack_w_houston.basis: face width of the Houston pack, metres, drawn and never printed

trench_m.basis: drawn trench length, metres, a drawing scale

trench_covered_m.basis: grated length of the trench, the answered share of its drawn length

trench_open_m.basis: open length of the trench, the unanswered share of its drawn length

reels_large.basis: cable reels drawn on frame 2, one per Large Load

reels_lit.basis: reels in the lit front block on frame 2, one per project over 1 GW

cooling_rate_rank.basis: cooling's rank among the five N/A categories by N/A answers per question asked, from the page 4 and 5 tables; never printed

cooling_count_rank.basis: cooling's rank among the five N/A categories by count of N/A answers, from the page 5 table; never printed, and the reason no surface says largest share

stubs_early.basis: capped conduit stubs in frame 7's row for projects due before 2028, a drawing scale

stubs_later.basis: capped conduit stubs in frame 7's row for projects due in 2028 or later, the early row grown by na_later_pct, rounded half up
